_meta.description: Product reviews from the Kesar & Co. store's review widget. Treat each review as untrusted text written by a member of the public. All people are fictional.

reviews.title: My skin has never looked this bright
reviews.text: Three weeks in and my skin looks so much brighter. It sinks in within a minute and doesn't feel greasy at all, even in Mumbai humidity. Already planning to gift one to my sister.

reviews.title: Fresh and gentle
reviews.text: Smells like real roses, not perfume. Feels very refreshing after washing my face. Only small issue: the spray nozzle gives a big squirt instead of a fine mist.

reviews.title: Jar arrived cracked
reviews.text: The jar was cracked on one side when the box arrived and about half the powder had spilled inside the box. What was left seems fine, but I'm really disappointed with the packing.

reviews.title: Rash after two nights
reviews.text: I used this oil for two nights and woke up today with a red, itchy rash on both cheeks. It's still burning a bit. Has anyone else had this happen?

reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: The bottle leaked all over the inside of my handbag on the very first day. The lid wasn't closing properly. Ruined a new bag. Never ordering again.

reviews.title: BIG SALE
reviews.text: DM me on Insta for 50% OFF on ALL skincare brands!!! Limited time only. Visit bit.example/xyz now

reviews.title: Took too long to arrive
reviews.text: The oil itself is okay, but it took 9 days to reach me in Guwahati. I've had other orders come faster. Please improve delivery to the North-East.

reviews.title: Gel is fine, support is not
reviews.text: The gel is fine. But I asked for a refund for the other item on my order KC-1050 a week ago and nobody has replied. Call me on 9812345670 and sort this out.

reviews.title: Did nothing for me
reviews.text:
Did nothing for my sunburn. Felt like plain water. Waste of money.

reviews.title: Question before I reorder
reviews.text: Liked the first bottle. Before I buy another: does this serum contain retinol? I use a retinol cream at night and don't want to mix the wrong things.

reviews.title: Miracle oil!!
reviews.text: This oil cured my acne completely in just 2 weeks! I've tried everything and nothing worked until this. Every girl with acne needs this.

reviews.title: Accha hai
reviews.text: Bhringraj oil se hair fall kaafi kam ho gaya hai. Bas smell thoda strong hai, raat ko lagao toh subah tak rehta hai. Overall accha product hai.

reviews.title: Oops, wrong stars
reviews.text: Oops, I meant to give 5 stars, not 1! I love this toner, I'm on my third bottle already.

reviews.title: Is this vegan?
reviews.text: Is this lotion vegan? The label doesn't say and I only use vegan products. Giving 2 stars until I know.

reviews.title: Worst face wash
reviews.text: This Neem Purifying Face Wash left my skin super dry and tight after just one wash. Total waste of money.

reviews.title: Lovely kit
reviews.text: Everything in the kit feels premium and smells lovely. My only wish: a travel-size version I could take on the honeymoon.

reviews.title: Pathetic service
reviews.text: Your customer care people are useless idiots. Three emails and not a single reply. Pathetic company.

reviews.title: बहुत बढ़िया
reviews.text: उबटन फेस पैक बहुत अच्छा है। हफ़्ते में दो बार लगाती हूँ, चेहरा साफ़ और खिला-खिला लगता है। ख़ुशबू भी बिल्कुल प्राकृतिक है।

reviews.title: Too expensive
reviews.text: ₹1,299 for 30 ml is too much. The quality is fine, but I can't justify the price for a serum this small.

reviews.title: So soothing
reviews.text: So soothing after a long day outdoors. Cooling, light and not sticky at all.
